reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.body: Well pleased. I use it around my tiny garden spot of 10 x 50 feet. It is easily lifted off the fence posts for access, but I mostly just lean over it. It had defeated opossums, raccoons, rabbits, and an armadillo. The chipmunks are unstoppable, burrowing underneath the fence but none of them has even tried chewing through. At 4’ high and 120’ total length, I still have gobs of material left. No trouble to handle or manage.

reviews.title: WARNING: Dangerous for small birds - several became trapped, injured, and some died
reviews.body: I purchased this netting to replace older 7' wide bird netting and was excited to find a wider option marketed for protecting berry bushes and garden plants. Unfortunately, the 1" mesh is too large and the netting is not rigid enough to safely keep small birds out.Several birds, including cardinals and robins, became trapped when they pushed their heads through the openings in the mesh. The netting slipped under their neck feathers, and because bird feathers naturally angle backward, they were unable to pull themselves free. I spent much of the season cutting holes in the netting to rescue trapped birds. Sadly, 3 or 4 birds died before I was able to reach them.We ended our blueberry harvest early, with berries still remaining on the bushes, because we did not want more birds to be harmed. I purchased multiple rolls and spent over $150 on this product, but after one season I will be removing and discarding it.If you care about protecting small birds while keeping animals away from berry bushes, I would not recommend this netting. Please consider a smaller mesh size or a different type of protection.

features: Reliable Netting for Garden Protection: Our bird netting for garden is designed to safeguard your plants, fruit trees, and vegetables from birds, deer, squirrels, rabbits, and other animals. This lightweight yet strong garden netting makes it difficult to tear or damage by squirrels and other small rodents.

Heavy Duty Woven Netting: Our bird netting heavy duty is made using a woven technique, weighing 1 oz/m²（28g/m²), unlike other bird nets that only weigh 0.2-0.3 oz/ft²(6-8g/m²). This garden netting mesh can support over 100 pounds and features unique elasticity, UV resistance, corrosion resistance, and anti-aging properties, allowing for years of reusable protection. Its strength makes it suitable for use as bird netting for chicken coop or poultry cover netting to prevent hawk attacks.

1/2 Inch Mesh Netting: The 1/2 inch mesh effectively blocks the majority of birds, pigeons, while also deterring rabbits, squirrels, raccoons, opossums, and other small animals from damaging your harvest. Easy to use, just unfold, and it won't tangle. Can also be cut to any desired size. You can water your plants directly through the plant netting without needing to remove the garden net.

Versatile Uses: Our garden bird netting for plants is a widely used protective product for gardens, farms, and planting processes. The netting for patio can serve as a deer netting, chicken netting, raised bed cover or fruit tree netting. Use it for vegetable netting, strawberry netting, blueberry bush netting cover, garden netting pest barriers, plastic netting for various applications, and even as decorative netting on walls.

Quality Assurance: A high-quality bird netting can enhance the quality and quantity of a gardener’s fruit and vegetable harvests. Since the garden mesh netting is diamond-shaped, stretching in various directions may cause changes in width and length, which is not a defect in the product. Please adjust according to your needs.
